title: Condition and Evidence Requirements by Return Schedule — Northbeam Returns and Restocking
content:
What has to come back in the carton, what has to be produced with the request, and how long the bench has to look at it, set out for each schedule of Northbeam Returns and Restocking.

## The requirement columns

Original packaging required means the original packaging must come back with the item. Accessories required means every accessory in the box must come back with it. Serial match required means the serial returned must match the serial sold. Proof of purchase required means proof of purchase must be produced to raise the return. Photographs required means photographs of the fault are required before a collection is booked.

| Return schedule | Original packaging | All accessories | Serial must match | Proof of purchase | Photographs |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | required | required | required | required | not required |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | not required | required | required | not required | not required |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | required | required | required | required | required |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | required | required | required | required | not required |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | required | required | required | required | not required |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | not required | required | required | not required | required |

## The bench columns

Inspection required means the item is inspected before the refund is worked out. Inspection days are the business days the inspection may take once the item is received. The missing accessory deduction is the amount taken off the refund for each missing accessory.

| Return schedule | Inspection required | Inspection days | Deduction for each missing accessory |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | yes | 3 business days | 19.00 USD |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | yes | 3 business days | 15.00 USD |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | yes | 5 business days | 35.00 USD |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | yes | 2 business days | 25.00 USD |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | yes | 5 business days | 0.00 USD |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | yes | 7 business days | 20.00 USD |

## Points of judgement

Two schedules, Member Extended Thirty Day Return and Business Contract Return Schedule, ask for neither the original packaging nor proof of purchase; every schedule asks for all of the accessories and for the serial to match, and every schedule has the item inspected. Photographs are asked for on the two schedules that bring goods back by crew, Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return and Business Contract Return Schedule. Open Box and Clearance Final Sale publishes a zero accessory deduction alongside five inspection days.
